subject: Joint Solution Studio: Redwood + CloudGrid — Technical deep dive scheduling
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@cloudgrid.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: partner@cloudgrid.io
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint Solution Studio — technical deep dive (CloudGrid + Redwood)

Hi Hannah / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudGrid's integration team and our marketplace ops folks want to run a 90–120 minute technical studio to validate the integration surface and deployment patterns (marketplace listing, IAM, billing integration, and network egress). Our suggested outcomes: a clear mutual action plan, a runbook for deployment on CloudGrid Marketplace, and an owner list for follow-ups.

Are you available for a technical deep dive the week of June 7? We can do mornings (PT) or afternoons (ET) — happy to accommodate. Tentative attendees from our side: Alicia Gomez (partnerships), Rajesh Iyer (platform engineer), and Mei Chen (security).

I can share our network topology and a short checklist ahead of time.

Best,
Alicia

--
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships, CloudGrid
alicia.gomez@cloudgrid.io
+1 (415) 555-0198

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Solution Studio — technical deep dive (CloudGrid + Redwood)

Hi Alicia — this sounds great and aligned with our plan to get the marketplace listing hardened before the pilot. We're available the week of June 7; two options that work for our engineering + integrations team:

- Tue, June 8, 10:00–11:30 PT (90 min)
- Thu, June 10, 13:00–15:00 PT (120 min)

Can you confirm which works best and send a final attendee list (names + roles)? Also helpful if you can flag any must-have agenda items (billing integration, auth flow, network whitelist).

I've attached a mutual action plan template — if you fill the top-level milestones we can align owners during the session.

Thanks,
Hannah

--

Adding Jonas (our integrations lead) here — Jonas, can you bring the marketplace packaging doc and the deployment checklist?

Alicia — we also have an internal architecture overview that maps to the integration points (auth, metrics export, billing hooks). I've attached the overview; it might help your platform folks prep.

Quick note on time: Thursday 13:00–15:00 PT would allow engineering to do a short prep sync beforehand, so I slightly prefer Thu 6/10. If you need shorter (90 min) we can tighten to Tue 6/8 at 10:00.

Camila

Hi all — thanks for the quick replies. Thu 10 Jun 13:00–15:00 PT works best for us (gives Rajesh and Mei time to join after their sprint planning). Confirmed attendees from CloudGrid: Alicia Gomez (partnerships), Rajesh Iyer (platform engineer), Mei Chen (security), and Tori Blake (marketplace ops).

A few prep asks so we can maximize the session:
- If you can populate the M.A.P. with tentative owners by EOD Wed 6/2 that would be great.
- We'll share a short network topology diagram (attached) and would like to validate outbound egress rules and any private connectivity options.
- Please let us know if there are any required service accounts or SCIM/SAML flows we should test live.

I've attached our topology diagram.

Best,
Alicia

Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Solution Studio — technical deep dive (CloudGrid + Redwood)

Thanks — I can own the packaging/deployment checklist. Two quick asks before the session:
1) Can CloudGrid provide a sample IAM policy or example role ARN we can test with?
2) Do you have a sandbox org we can use for an end-to-end deploy during the workshop? If not, we can provision a short-lived test account but would prefer using your sandbox to avoid license churn.

I've created a shared prep folder and added a draft runbook (link below). If someone from CloudGrid can drop the IAM sample there that would speed up the live validation.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Redwood-CloudGrid-Prep

- 13:00–13:10 Intro & outcomes (Hannah / Alicia)

- 14:00–14:25 Security & auth flows (Mei / Camila)
- 14:25–14:45 Billing and marketplace billing hooks (Hannah / Tori)
- 14:45–15:00 Action items, owners, next steps

Action items before the session:

- CloudGrid: drop sample IAM and any sandbox access details in shared folder (by EOD Wed 6/2).
- Alicia: confirm attendee emails so Jonas can add ACLs to the test artifacts.
